metricDefinitions.label: Registry scope
metricDefinitions.definition: The 55 entries include saved data, product documentation, identity/reference material and explicit gaps; the count does not represent 55 working integrations.

caveats: Fourteen selected GET requests were rechecked; remaining access statuses are historical.
Six managed routes tested in this pass returned 401, and the daily rainfall catalogue attempt timed out.
Administrative geography, warning lifecycle, field context and language evaluation remain incomplete.

evidenceFlow.title: Requirement review
evidenceFlow.detail: Reviewed the original 38 entries against the eight supplied features and added 17 explicit product/reference/gap entries.

metricDefinitions.label: Processed records
metricDefinitions.definition: The build preserves 17 published monthly, seasonal and annual measures per year for each of two All India climate series from 1901 to 2024.

caveats: Monthly, seasonal and annual periods overlap and must not be added across period types.
All 4,216 cells round-trip to source values; this does not establish scientific homogeneity or district representativeness.
Six rainfall totals exceed the stated rounding bound; published values are preserved and flagged.

evidenceFlow.title: Processing verification
evidenceFlow.detail: SQLite integrity returned ok; 4,216 original cells matched, and all 11 targeted unit tests passed.

methods.code:
from pathlib import Path
import csv, io, json, sqlite3, hashlib
from collections import Counter

root = next(p for p in [Path.cwd(), *Path.cwd().parents] if (p / "weathergpt_data/climate.py").exists())
registry = json.loads((root / "data/registry/sources.json").read_text())
by_id = {s["id"]: s for s in registry["products"]}
output = root / by_id["S25"]["processing_outputs"]["directory"]
manifest = json.loads((output / "build-manifest.json").read_text())
for name, expected in manifest["outputs"].items():
    assert hashlib.sha256((output / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected
for item in manifest["inputs"]:
    assert hashlib.sha256((root / item["path"]).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == item["sha256"]
with sqlite3.connect(output / "climate.sqlite") as con:
    print("SQLite integrity:", con.execute("PRAGMA integrity_check").fetchone()[0])
    print("Rows by source:", con.execute("SELECT source_id, COUNT(*) FROM climate_records GROUP BY source_id").fetchall())
    checked = 0
    for item in manifest["inputs"]:
        raw = list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO((root / item["path"]).read_text())))
        rows = con.execute("SELECT source_row, source_column, native_value FROM climate_records WHERE source_id=?", (item["source_id"],)).fetchall()
        for row, col, native in rows:
            assert raw[row-2][col] == native
            checked += 1
    print("Original CSV cells matched:", checked)
    print("2024 published annual rainfall:", con.execute("SELECT value_decimal, unit, quality_flags FROM climate_records WHERE source_id='S25' AND year=2024 AND period_code='ANNUAL'").fetchone())
audit = json.loads((output / "audit.json").read_text())
print("Missing values:", audit["missing_values"])
print("Rainfall totals exceeding rounding bound:", len(audit["rainfall_totals_beyond_rounding_bound"]))
